description: The apex-dispatch ledger event schema. ledger.sh append validates each row's caller-supplied fields against `required` (field -> type), `one_of` (a list of {field: type} groups: exactly one field of each group is present, with its type), `enums` (the allowed values of a field, when present) and `items` (the type of every element of an array field), then stamps the fields in `stamped`. An event declares no other key. Events marked `provenance` are written in-process only (route.py, hooks, shims importing scripts/lib/ledger.py); the ledger.sh CLI refuses them. Types: string, integer, number (finite), boolean, object, array, count (an integer >= 0), sha (a full 40- or 64-hex lowercase commit SHA), slug (kebab-case [a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*), id (1-128 of [A-Za-z0-9_.:-], starting with a letter or digit); a trailing '|null' allows null. Extra fields are kept as given.

route.description: route.sh emitted (or, in baseline/shadow mode, computed) a route.

spawn_request.description: pre-agent.sh allowed an Agent/Task spawn for the active route.

spawn.description: subagent-start.sh registered a running subagent (agent_id -> role -> route_id); post-agent.sh may add usage and resolved_model.

worker_run.description: A worker finished: post-agent.sh for an in-session subagent (provider claude-session; resolved_model, usage, duration_ms, tool_count, usd_estimate) or a provider shim (bin/worker-*.sh).

verdict.description: A reviewer verdict captured by subagent-stop.sh or a shim result.json, bound to a head. UNPARSED = no final, parseable APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES (fail-closed: blocks complete at that head); stale = HEAD moved while the reviewer ran (bound to the start head).

worker_applied.description: scripts/apply.sh committed a write-mode shim worker's patch to the plan worktree (Dispatch-* trailers); head_sha is the new commit.

worker_rejected.description: scripts/apply.sh refused a write-mode shim worker's patch (kept under <D>/rejected/); counts against the provider's rolling acceptance.

model_mismatch.description: post-agent.sh: a builder-side subagent ran on a model family other than the route's ROUTE_MODEL (advisory; the spawn was already pinned by pre-agent.sh).

policy_violation.description: subagent-stop.sh: a read-only role's transcript shows a write, an agent spawn or a git mutation; its review record is refused.

escalate.description: route.sh escalate chose the next rung of the escalation ladder.

hook_error.description: A hook failed open (unparseable stdin, internal error).

hook_advisory.description: A hook allowed something it noted (e.g. an open route with no progress).

human_gate.description: A human gate was opened or answered (G12, budget exhaustion).

baseline.description: ledger.sh baseline capture: the environment a baseline/shadow comparison is measured against.

decision_shadow.description: An uncalibrated decision-layer answer logged beside the deterministic choice.

operate_deploy.description: apex-scope-loop operate.sh deploy ran $APEX_DEPLOY_CMD for a landed plan after the human ack (APEX_OPERATE_ACK=<slug>@<landed sha>); exit_code is the command's exit status.

operate_signal.description: apex-scope-loop operate.sh monitor/ingest: one validated measurement of a declared check, for exactly one of slug (a plan's check) or repo: true (a repo-level check). value is null when the probe was unmeasured (timeout, bad output): never 0 and never a string. sink: where ingest filed the breach (lessons, backlog), or counted (a repeat of a filed breach, or no breach).

operate_window_closed.description: apex-scope-loop operate.sh: a plan's watch window ended and measurement of it stops. open_at_close lists the ids of the checks still breaching on the last run.
